summary: Hermes-Epitek Corp. is a leading provider of semiconductor and opto-electronic manufacturing equipment, offering a range of solutions including ICP Etchers and Ion Beam Implanters. The company focuses on delivering optimized equipment performance and comprehensive support services to its clients across the global semiconductor industry.
